summary: A large set of gtests was added to harden encoders, decoders, and media timing: AV1 SVC temporal ID parsing/preservation, encoder bitrate/mode selection and hardware preference, color metadata handling through FFmpeg and hardware decoders, clock and A/V drift regressions, picture-region/image-conversion edge cases, and many more unit tests for message ordering and shutdown. These C++ tests improve confidence across formats (AV1, WebM, FFmpeg paths), hardware codecs (VideoToolbox/WMF), and timing-sensitive features so regressions are caught earlier.
